title: Optimized fps droid
description: This is a modpack that improves FPS for potato-based machines, and these mods are accepted on major servers like donut.smp and mcpvp.club. The main mod is sodium, and the mods help improve FPS.
body:
I am the author of the modpack "Optimized FPS Droid".
This modpack is focused on improving Minecraft performance and FPS while keeping the vanilla gameplay experience unchanged.
All mods included in this modpack are publicly available on Modrinth and are distributed according to their respective licenses and permissions. The main optimization mod used in this modpack is Sodium, along with other performance-focused mods.
This modpack does not contain cheats, hacks, exploits, or copyrighted content used without permission.
The modpack is designed to be compatible with a wide range of launchers, including PojavLauncher, Zalith Launcher 1, Zalith Launcher 2, Mojo Launcher, Fold Craft, DroidBridge, and PC launchers that support Modrinth modpacks.
If there are any issues with the project or any information that needs to be corrected, please let me know and I will make the necessary changes.
Thank you for reviewing my project.
Best regards,by VanKiepDaoThe
